rows.57:04d0:
Let's see.
This is out of the blue, but have any of you ever run into a pervert?
Yes, the kind you often find on trains.
Perverts turn up in all sorts of places.
Dark streets at night, parks, swimming pools... I hear all kinds of stories from the girls.
As a man, that's something I just can't forgive.
The thing is, there's a dangerous pervert lurking near our school.
Every woman he attacks gets killed.
Haven't you heard? Just recently, in another area, there was a string of murders of women.
Apparently they still haven't caught the culprit.
The way I read it, that culprit has been prowling around this neighborhood lately.
I saw a guy who matched the culprit's description from the news.
Near... this school.
He had a weirdly nasty look in his eyes, and his face was deathly pale.
His figure floated dimly in the dark of night.
He was staring and staring at our school.
He looked kind of like a ghost.{p}
rows.57:07f8:
I got really worried, you know.
So I went through the newspapers, looking into the area where the first incidents happened.
The ones who were killed were all high school girls.
Do you get it, {b}?
High school girls, just like you.
...So, I was reading through newspaper after newspaper.
And I found an article that caught my eye.
It was a pervert case too, of course.
The culprit in that case ran into a woman who fought back, and while they were grappling, his head got slammed against the ground... well, you get the idea.{p}
rows.57:0990:
That's right, the culprit hit his head in just the wrong spot, and he died.
And the photo of that culprit looked kind of like the guy I saw near this school.
It clicked for me right away.
I figured the dead culprit had become a ghost and was still attacking girls even now.
The police wouldn't think that way, after all.
Even if similar cases happen in the same area, once the culprit in one of them is dead, they'd figure it has nothing to do with the other one...{p}
rows.57:0f90:
Hmm.
But you know, it's already pitch-dark outside.
Whoever it is might've already gone home for the day, right?
Well, I'm sure something came up.
Like I said earlier, it's dangerous around here.
You'd better do the seventh interview some other time.
Come on, let's go, let's go.{p}
